# viettelcloud_fs_filesystem_snapshot (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud File Storage filesystem snapshot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "filesystem_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "viettelcloud_fs_filesystem_snapshot" "data" {
  name        = "example-data-snapshot"
  description = "Before the application upgrade"
  filesystem  = { id = var.filesystem_id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filesystem` (Attributes) Source filesystem. Changing it replaces the snapshot. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filesystem))
- `name` (String) Snapshot name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Snapshot description. Omitting it preserves the current value. An empty string clears it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC3339).
- `filesystem_name` (String) Name of the source filesystem.
- `from_policy` (Boolean) Whether a policy created the snapshot.
- `id` (String) Snapshot ID (UUID).
- `owner_id` (String) Owner ID (UUID).
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID).
- `size` (Number) Snapshot size in GiB.
- `status` (String) Current snapshot status.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC3339).

<a id="nestedatt--filesystem"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filesystem`

Required:

- `id` (String) Filesystem ID (UUID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import viettelcloud_fs_filesystem_snapshot.data 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
```
